source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: SetTextboxFocus formerly called input.focus only when input existed. Inlining that call removes the fallback unless the caller guards the receiver, as ValidateNumber and link-text validation do. The actual HTML-name control is an editable menulist whose focus override forwards to an internal input. Preserve the receiver and its absence contract when removing a wrapper; this local change does not justify deleting null guards or treating every focus call as a built-in API.
title: Inlining the dialog focus helper preserves receiver dispatch but removes its null fallback
